_doc: Party links open the app (docs/plans/moba/DEEP-LINKS.md). Source of public/.well-known/apple-app-site-association, public/apple-app-site-association and public/.well-known/assetlinks.json: edit this file, then run `node scripts/app-links.mjs` and commit the outputs. `npm run build` refuses when they differ or a fingerprint is malformed.

ios._doc: Team ID and bundle id from pawlegends-app/ios/App/App.xcodeproj (DEVELOPMENT_TEAM, PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER).

android._doc: SHA-256 certificate fingerprints (AA:BB:... 32 bytes) that sign the installed app. Founder step: Play Console → Paw Legends → Test and release → App integrity → App signing: copy the SHA-256 of the 'App signing key certificate' (what Play installs), and of the 'Upload key certificate' (internal sideloads), into sha256. Empty: no assetlinks.json is published and Android opens party links in the browser.
